0022600008.text: The New York Knicks, 0-1 and 8th in the East, visit the Boston Celtics, also 0-1 and 11th in the East, for the second game of the Knicks' 2026-27 season. The Knicks sit 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, and are looking for their first win after losing their only game so far. Boston is missing Devin Carter, who is out with illness, while the Knicks won the last meeting 112-106 in New York on April 9, 2026, and took the 2025-26 season series 3-1.
